expectations.description: A tool that resolves with a string gets the string itself back from executeTool(), not its JSON serialization: "hi" gives hi. Chromium stringifies primitive results (ToolFunctionFinishedCallback in third_party/blink/renderer/core/script_tools/model_context.cc), and WPT asserts that.
A tool that resolves with "" gets the string Operation succeeded back instead of the JSON "".
A tool that resolves with undefined gets the string undefined back, where the spec rejects with OperationError because undefined has no JSON serialization.

getTools() Tools have no outputSchema attribute and no source (they have a window member instead, so every Tool prints as from @undefined), and an absent inputSchema or annotations reads as undefined instead of null. Fixed by Chrome Canary 160.0.8177.0. Only the getTools() view is covered: registerTool() also skips outputSchema validation, which changes the tool map, so that stays unexpected.
A tool whose callback throws or rejects makes executeTool() reject with UnknownError; the spec has used OperationError since webmcp#339. Fixed by Chrome Canary 160.0.8177.0.
Executing a Tool whose registration is gone rejects with UnknownError instead of NotFoundError (webmcp#339). Fixed by Chrome Canary 160.0.8177.0.
